t: Beezeh maqom yakol lehapsiq ubeezeh maqom lo yapsiq
s: Beezeh maqom yakol lehapsiq ubeezeh maqom lo yapsiq ubo y"g seipim: ap al pi sheasur lesapper bebirkot qeriat shema apillu bedibre tora vaapillu bilshon haqqodesh — hittiru sheilat shalom mippene hayyira umippene hakkabod umippene darke shalom. Ketzad? Ben pereq lepereq — shoel bishlom adam nikbad mippene kebodo, umeshib shalom lekol adam mippene darke shalom. Umuttar lishol bishlom haqqore ap al pi sheyyodea sheyyitztarek lehashib lo. Umi shello rainu sheyyaqpid al chabero kelal — lo yapsiq apillu ben happeraqim (ben lehashib ben lishol mippene hakkabod). Ubeemtza happereq — shoel bishlom adam mi shehu yare mimmennu, kegon abiv, shenneemar bo: "ish immo veabiv tirau", o rabbo, sheameru bo: mora rabbak kemora shamayim, umeshib shalom lekol adam nikbad. Vekol talmid chakam shehu muplag bedoro ap al pi sheeno rabbo — hu gam ken biklal mora. Veim eno muplag bedoro raq shehu gadol mimmennu bechokma — eno biklal mora ella biklal kabod. Abal im haqqore gadol mimmennu — en mapsiq lo ella kemo lishar kol adam, ap al pi shehu talmid chakam:

Kol maqom shemmuttar lehapsiq beemtza happereq — muttar apillu beemtza happasuq. Chutz mippasuq "shema yisrael" shello yapsiq bo kelal, im lo mippene mi sheyyare mimmennu shemma yahargennu. Vehu haddin le"baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", sheggam hu biklal hayyichud. Umittaam zeh en lehapsiq gam ken ben "shema yisrael" le"baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed". Veyesh omerim sheapillu beemtza shear happesuqim — lo yapsiq ella besiyyum inyan, abal lo beemtza hainyan, kegon pasuq "vesamtem vego'" — yakol lehapsiq ben "napshekem" le"uqeshartam" shehu inyan acher, abal ad "napshekem" lo yapsiq ben teba leteba shehu beemtza hainyan. Veim pasaq — chozer litchillat happasuq (shehaek yatchil meemtza hainyan, shello yihyeh perush kelal lidbarayv). Uleinyan maaseh, keshemmapsiq laaniyyat qaddish veliqdushsha ul"bareku" kemo sheyyitbaer — yakol lehapsiq apillu beemtza hainyan, velismok al baale sebara harishona shello chillequ bekak vehittiru bekol inyan, ukeday hem lismok alehem letzorek mitzva rabba kazo, im i epshar lemaher lehaggia lesiyyum inyan velaanot im hatztzibbur. Abal keshechozer lammaqom sheppasaq — yesh lachush lassebara haacharona lachazor litchillat happasuq:

Im shakach lehaniach tzitzit utepillin — yesh omerim sheyakol lehapsiq ben happeraqim lahanichan ulebarek alehen. Veyesh omerim shettepillin mippene shechoba liqrot ulehitpallel bahen kede leqabbel malkut shamayim shelema — mapsiq lahanichan vibarek gam ken. Abal tzitzit enah chobat haggup sheim en alayv tallit patur mitztzitzit, veyakol liqrot veeno kemeid edut sheqer, kevan sheen alayv tallit hachayyebet batztzitzit. Lepikak asur lehapsiq bebirkatan apillu ben happeraqim shel qeriat shema ubirkoteha, ella lobeshan belo beraka, uleachar hattepilla yemashmesh bahen vibarek. Veken yesh linhog halaka lemaaseh:

Laaniyyat qaddish uqedushsha u"bareku" va"modim" — mapsiq apillu beemtza happereq vaapillu beemtza happasuq, sheim mapsiq lishol mippene hayyira ulehashib mippene hakkabod shel basar vadam — qal vachomer lakkabod shel haqqadosh baruk hu. Umittaam zeh hu haddin im shama qol reamim — yapsiq vibarek:

Keshemmapsiq le"modim" — yishcheh veyomar "modim anachnu lak" velo yoter, shebbazeh day shello yihyeh nireh kekoper bemi shechaberayv mishtachavim umodim lo. Ukeshemmapsiq le"bareku" — lo yomar raq "baruk Hashem hamborak leolam vaed", velo nussach "yitbarak veyishtabbach ku'" sheeno ella minhag, vaapillu bipsuqe dezimra en mapsiqin leomro. Ukeshemmapsiqim leqaddish — yomar "amen yehe shemeh rabba" ad "yitbarek" vead biklal, veyishma mehashsheliach tzibbur ad "veimru amen", veyaaneh amen, ki yesh machaloqet im chayyab lomar kol hannussach mi"yitbarek" veelak kemo shennitbaer besiman (n"h) [n"v], laken en lehapsiq baamirato bemaqom sheasur lehapsiq. Umikkol maqom tebat "yitbarek" tzarik lomar, mittaam shennitbaer sham. Umi"titqabbel" veelak lo yaaneh amen, ki ena ella minhag. Vekol shekken hannohagin lomar "veatta yigdal na vego'" qodem shemmatchil hashsheliach tzibbur yitgaddal, sheen mapsiqin leomro bekol maqom sheasur lehapsiq. Ubiqqedushsha — yomar raq "qadosh" u"baruk", velo "yimlok", she"yimlok" en omerim hammalakim, veeno meiqqar haqqedushsha. Veyesh mi sheomer sheggam "yimlok" hu meiqqar haqqedusha. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Uledibre hakkol nussach shemmosipin beshabbat — eno minnussach haqqedushsha, veen omerim oto bemaqom sheasur lehapsiq. Veal birkat hattora yaaneh "baruk Hashem hamborak leolam vaed", vegam amen achar "noten hattora", mippene shebberaka zo hi gam ken kemo dabar shebbiqqedusha, shehare enah neemeret al qeriat seper tora ella kesheqqorin baasara. Abal achar shear berakot en onin amen biqriat shema ubirkoteha apillu ben happeraqim, chutz min amen sheonin achar birkat "hael haqqadosh" veamen sheachar "shomea tepilla" sheyyesh lahem din dabar shebbiqqedushsha — onin otan apillu beemtza happasuq:

Kohen shehaya qore qeriat shema uqerauhu liqrot battora — yesh omerim sheeno mapsiq, shello ameru lehaqdimo ella mishshum kebod kehunnato, veim haya panuy umaqdimin acher lepanayv — nimtza meqillin likbod kehunnato, abal zeh sheeno yakol liqrot mishshum qeriat shema — en bekan zilzul likbod kehunnato bemah sheoleh yisrael bimqomo. Veyesh omerim sheapillu yisrael sheqqore qeriat shema uqerauhu laalot leseper tora — mapsiq apillu beemtza happereq, qal vachomer mikkebod habberiyyot veyiratam. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu. Veen leshannot hamminhag, mippene hammachaloqet. Umikkol maqom, lo yiqra im hachazzan kelal, veyismok al dibre haomerim sheyakol lebarek al shemia mehachazzan kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qm"a. Umikkol shekken shello yapsiq veyomar lehachazzan sheyyomar "mi shebberak". Veachar kak chozer lammaqom sheppasaq biqriat shema, veen tzarik lachazor larosh apillu shaha kede ligmor et kullah, kevan sheshshaha birtzono shezzeh eno niqra ones kelal, ubelo ones kelal — hakkol modim, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"h:

Veellu hen ben happeraqim: ben beraka rishona lishniyya, ben sheniyya li"shema", ben "shema" li"vehaya im shamoa", ben "vehaya im shamoa" le"vayyomer". Abal ben "vayyomer" le"emet veyatztzib" — lo yapsiq beshum inyan, shello lehapsiq ben "Hashem eloqekem" le"emet", mishshum shenneemar: "vaHashem eloqim emet", ella yomar "ani Hashem eloqekem emet", veaz yapsiq kedin hepseq beemtza happereq. Veyesh lizzaher lomar gam "veyatztzib", lepi she"veyatztzib" hu gam ken leshon emet, al ken en lehapsiq be[no] le"h' eloqekem" bedibbur acher ella bemillat "emet" bilbaddah:

Im pasaq mippene hayyira o hakkabod achar sheamar "emet", veken im siyyem "Hashem elohekem emet" qodem hashsheliach tzibbur, umamtin al hashsheliach tzibbur sheyyomar immo birkat "emet veyatztzib" — eno chozer veomer "emet", ella matchil mi"veyatztzib" o mimmaqom sheppasaq:

Tzarik lismok geulla litpilla mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman qy"a, velo yapsiq achar shessiyyem "gaal yisrael" apillu kemo beemtza happereq. Velaken yesh omerim sheen onin amen achar "gaal yisrael", lo achar birkat atzmo apillu bemaqom shenohagin laanot achar birkot atzmo besiyyum b' o g' berakot, velo achar hashsheliach tzibbur. Veyesh omerim sheaniyyat amen enah chashuba hepseq, kevan shehi tzorek habberaka vesiyyumah. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu laanot amen ben geulla litpilla achar shemmesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur beraka zo, abal lo achar birkat atzmo, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"d. Umi sherotzeh latzet ledibre hakkol — yukal lekavven lesayyem im hashsheliach tzibbur, veaz eno mechuyyab laanot amen achar hashsheliach tzibbur, lepi minhagenu sheen onin amen achar birkat atzmo apillu achar "yishtabbach", vekayyotze bo mimmeqomot shemmuttar laanot amen achar hashsheliach tzibbur, kemo shennitbaer sham ubesiman n"a. Veyesh medaqdeqim lehamtin be"tzur yisrael kede laanot amen achar hashsheliach tzibbur . Veyesh omerim sheasur lehapsiq beemtza habberaka baaniyyat amen, apillu amen sheachar beraka zo beatzmah, ella beamen shehu kemo dabar shebbiqdushsha kemo shennitbaer lemala (ulepikak en lazuz bazeh mehamminhag, o yaaseh beinyan sheyyotze ledibre hakkol):

En lehapsiq laanot qaddish uqedushsha ben geulla litpilla kemo sheen mapsiqin battepilla atzmah, shemmissiyyum haggeulla hu hatchalat hattepilla. Veketzad hu oseh? Mamtin be"shira chadasha" kede laanot, vaapillu im shoheh kede ligmor et kullah — en bekak kelum, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"h:

Mi sheen lo tepillin vehatztzibbur mitpalelim — mutab sheyyitakkeb ad achar tepillat hatztzibbur lishol lo tepillin mechabero, kede sheyyiqra qeriat shema veyitpallel bitpillin viqabbel alayv malkut shamayim shelema, mimmah sheyyitpallel im hatztzibbur belo tepillin veyaid edut sheqer beatzmo. Abal mi shemmityare shemma yaabor zeman qeriat shema ad sheyyimtza tepillin — qore qeriat shema belo tepillin. Veim mityare shemma yaabor gam zeman tepilla — mitpallel gam ken, ukesheyyabou tepillin leyado achar kak — yenichen bemincha, o yenichen beemtza hayyom veyomar bahem ezeh mizmor. Veim bau leyado ben qeriat shema litpilla — yesh omerim sheen mapsiqin lebarek alehen ella ben happeraqim abal lo beemtza happereq, lepikak mi"vayyomer" veelak — yenichen belo beraka, veachar hattepilla yemashmesh bahem vibarek. Veyesh omerim apillu beemtza happereq yakol lebarek alehen, abal lo ben geulla litpilla, shehare dino kemo beemtza hattepilla mammash apillu laanot qaddish o qedushsha shehi mitzva oberet, vekol shekken bebirkat hattepillin sheyakol lebarek achar kak. Veken yesh linhog. Vekol zeh bitpillin shehen choba litpilla kede leqabbel malkut shamayim shelema, abal tzitzit sheen chobat haggup ella kesheyyesh alayv tallit hachayyebet batztzitzit — lo yapsiq lehitattep bah ben geulla litpilla apillu belo beraka, shehaittup chashub gam ken hepseq battepilla atzmah kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (tz"g) [tz"z], vehu haddin ben geulla litpilla kevan sheen bo tzorek kol kak litpilla, abal qodem shessiyyem "gaal yisrael" yakol lehitattep belo beraka apillu beemtza happereq, shehare apillu laasoq bimlakto muttar beod shehu qore qeriat shema chutz mibbeparasha rishona, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"g:

Kol mi shello amar birkat "emet veyatztzib" shacharit (kemo shettiqqenuhu) ve"emet veemuna" arbit ap al pi sheyyatza yede qeriat shema, shehabberakot enan meakkebot et qeriat shema (apillu lo amaran kelal) — lo yatza yede chobat hammitzva ketiqqunah, shenneemar: "lehaggid babboqer chasdeka veemunateka ballelot", ubirkat "emet veyatztzib" kullah hu al chesed sheasa im abotenu, shehotziam mimmitzrayim ubaqa lahem hayyam veheebiram, ubirkat "emet veemuna" medabber bah gam al haatidot, sheanu metzappim sheyyeqayyem lanu habtachato veemunato legoolenu miyyad melakim umiyyad aritzim, velasum napshenu bachayyim, ulehadrikenu al bamot oyebenu, kol elleh hannissim hattedirim tamid. Ubesop beraka chozer ligullat mitzrayim, kede lismok le"gaal yisrael" shehu leshon abar. Umah shennohagim lesayyem be"maarabit" "melek tzur yisrael vegoalo" — en limchot, mippene shelshon zeh kolel gam ken leshon abar, shelshon "goel" kolel abar vehoveh veatid (kemo "motzi lechem" shekkolel gam abar, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"z). Vetzarik lehazkir yetziat mitzrayim umalkut uqeriat yam sup umakkot bekorot be"emet veyatztzib". Veken be"emet veemuna". Veim lo hizkir achat mehen — lo yatza yede chobato (umachazirin oto). Abal shear hannussach, im shinna oto velo amar oto leshon ella benussach acher, vaapillu im dilleg harbeh — yatza. Veken hu benussach shear kol habberakot haarukkot. Velo ameru shehamshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim lo yatza, ella keshemmeshanneh biptichatan o bachatimatan, abal shear hannussach — eno meakkeb ella hattebot shepperetu chakamim shehen meakkebot, kegon ellu sheamarnu (ukegon berit vetora umalkut bebirkat hammazon, ugeshamim battepilla, vekol kayyotze bahen):

Im en penay laadam lehitpallel beonat qeriat shema velismok geulla litpilla — yiqra qeriat shema beonatah belo birkoteha, veachar kak yiqraenna bebirkoteha, veyismok geulla litpilla. Veyesh omerim sheyyakol gam ken lomar berakot shellepaneha uleshayyer birkat "emet veyatztzib", veachar kak lismok geulla litpilla:
